description: Source code for Windows network interface utilities in Chromium project, including functions to retrieve network interfaces, connection attributes, and Wi-Fi details.

classes.name: ScopedWifiOptions
classes.description: Base class for managing Wi-Fi options scope.

classes.name: WifiOptionSetter
classes.description: Sets Wi-Fi options such as disable scan and media streaming mode for interfaces.

classes.name: WlanApi
classes.description: Handles dynamic loading and access to wlanapi.dll functions.

methods.name: GetNetworkInterfaceType
methods.description: Converts Windows interface type to internal network connection type.

methods.name: GetNetworkListImpl
methods.description: Populates network list from adapter info.

methods.name: GetNetworkList
methods.description: Retrieves list of network interfaces on Windows.

methods.name: GetWifiPHYLayerProtocol
methods.description: Determines Wi-Fi physical layer protocol type.

methods.name: SetWifiOptions
methods.description: Creates a scope object to set Wi-Fi options.

methods.name: GetWifiSSID
methods.description: Retrieves the SSID of the current Wi-Fi connection.
